figures.caption: Interaction of LS-sarcotoxin (LS-sarc.) and LS-stomoxyn (LS-stom.) with colistin tested on E. coli ATCC 25922 (a), A. baumannii ATCC 19606 (b) and P. aeruginosa ATCC 27853 (c). The data points of the isobolograms represent the concentrations of the two individual compounds in different combinations leading to complete bacterial growth inhibition. The calculated FICIs are displayed in (d). Values ≤0.5 indicate synergy.
